meaning:
παρ-ίημι
[in LXX: Jer.4:31 (פָּרַשׂ pi.), etc. ;]
1. to pass by or over, let alone, disregard: Luk.11:42.
2. to relax, loosen; pass., to be relaxed, weakened, exhausted: παρειμένας χεῖρας, Heb.12:12 (LXX ἀνειμ-).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
